freeze_context.reason: Added after the definition-level Muon and NorMuon fingerprints were judged insufficient as a novel mechanism claim.

long_horizon_effect.aggregation: median over the four frozen learning-rate points within family and optimizer

required_conditions: challenger local margin effect is smaller than AdamW
challenger final median unseen margin is larger than AdamW
challenger final median BEIR nDCG@10 is larger than AdamW

acquisition_preservation.selection_rule: validation-frozen recipe from the independent 4096-query training-domain validation set
acquisition_preservation.oracle_comparator: highest final discovery BEIR point within the same family and optimizer
acquisition_preservation.interpretation: The oracle comparator is descriptive and cannot be used for confirmatory recipe selection.

claim_boundary: This post-hoc analysis can establish a descriptive local-to-global sign reversal and an acquisition-preservation mismatch in the completed discovery seed. It cannot establish that spectral equalization causes the long-horizon gain; that requires the frozen shared-start branches and additional spectral interventions.
